comment: BLOCKED by topl.c remember_topl(): the port's message history keeps the farlook line's DECgraphics room glyph as its decoded ASCII letter, where C stores the high-bit byte 0xFE. Independent C-first gnomish Healer with DECgraphics and msg_window:full. ';' farlooks the floor east of the hero, whose message opens with that glyph, and Ctrl-P shows it in the Message History text window. wintty.c process_text_window() sends the high-bit first byte through g_putch(), whose recorder hook (patch 006) stores it one column right, where the following space overwrites it, so C leaves column 0 of that row blank (step 9). scripts/tty-menu.test.mjs cites this for the leading-high-byte column.
